verdict.rationale: TWC documents its own bulk mechanism: the free QuickFile tool reports more than 1000 employees at once from a formatted file. That makes bulk wage reporting a first-party capability, but it is limited to that one operation, and the probe shows the online tax application host resets keyless agent connections, so AI-driven bulk use is unproven. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond wage reporting, a programmatic or API bulk interface (no OpenAPI found), agent-accessible bulk endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of QuickFile.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Install QuickFile for free to report over 1000 employees directly from a formatted file on your computer.
